build_CLIP_model: build a CLIP model with custom vision and text config dataclasses for multimodal embedding
build_model_from_openai_state_dict: build a CLIP model from an OpenAI pretrained state dict with QuickGELU activation
encode_image_features: encode an image tensor through the CLIP visual tower and optionally normalize output
encode_text_features: encode a text token tensor through the CLIP text transformer and optionally normalize output
convert_weights_to_fp16: convert all applicable model parameters to float16 low precision for memory efficiency
